messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — incoming support ticket from Acme (TKT-4321). They want streaming chat responses that can call customer tools mid-stream and return structured JSON chunks for downstream processing. Asking for low-latency partial outputs and function-calling in the same stream.
TicketBot: New support ticket TKT-4321 created by acme-support at 2026-03-20T08:12:03Z — https://tickets/internal/4321 (priority: P2)
Sara Gomez: adding context from the ticket: customer has a product that streams real-time recommendations into a trading dashboard. Current workaround is polling completions which is too slow. They highlighted two blockers: 1) function/tool calls only at end-of-stream 2) streaming doesn't include structured schema enforcement.
Ben Patel: thanks — we should triage. High-level Qs: do they need guaranteed order of events? and will they accept object-per-line JSON or want envelope+schema validation?
Jordan Li: sales note — Acme is on a Dedicated plan, willing to pay for expedited feature work if we can promise an ETA and can scope a private deploy patch.
Alex Rivera: engineering perspective: streaming with in-flight tool calls is doable but requires changes across runtime (KV cache resume, partial token commit) and protocol surface (responses + tool call frames). Risk: ~2-3 sprints for safe rollout if we include structured output validation.
Mike O'Connor: rough tech sketch: propose a streaming envelope where server emits frames like: ```
{ "type": "partial", "payload": { ... } }
{ "type": "tool_call", "tool": "trade-eval", "args": { ... } }
{ "type": "final", "payload": { ... } }
```
This keeps backwards compatibility and lets clients process incremental JSON. Need to add a "resume_token" for reconnects.
Maria Chen: product asks: what are minimal acceptance criteria to push this to backlog as a scoped initiative? Suggestion: (a) streaming tool-call frame + basic schema envelope, (b) reconnect/resume token, (c) docs and SDK example for Node/Python.
Ben Patel: I agree. Also add QA: end-to-end test with a simulated tool that returns binary payloads, and perf target: <150ms median token latency for incremental frames under dedicated capacity.
Sara Gomez: support priority: mark as "customer-driven" and request engineering contact for a feasibility call with Acme next week. I'll schedule.
Alex Rivera: tentative implementation plan: 1) spec PR (2 dev days) 2) runtime changes + unit tests (2-3 weeks) 3) SDK + docs (1 week) 4) canary in Dedicated region (1 week). Total ~5-6 weeks if no major infra blockers.
Jordan Li: sales will confirm budget for expedited work. If they fund, we can move it up in prioritization — ping me when you have a firm estimate.
Maria Chen: decision: move to "requires scoping" in backlog. Ben/Alex, please draft a spec doc with acceptance criteria and perf targets. Sara will coordinate customer-facing timeline.
Mike O'Connor: will start a draft spec and post here by EOD. Will include sample wire-format, reconnect behavior, and rollback strategy.
Ben Patel: cool — also include migration notes for customers already using streaming completions (compat mode).
Sara Gomez: noted, scheduling customer sync for Wed 10am PT. @Jordan Li can you join?
Jordan Li: can do.
Maria Chen: thanks everyone. tag @TicketBot once we have the spec to update TKT-4321 with estimated ETA and the feature gate we plan to use. :+1:
TicketBot: Ticket TKT-4321 updated: spec draft attached (private link) — status: "scoped".
